evidence: decorative_mascot: Data stands at the edge of the scale in hook@0.3 to seg0:end, beside the bar in seg1:mid, beside the column in seg2:mid, and on top of the circle in seg3:start to seg4:end. He never pours, tips or causes anything. He only stands, rides or cheers.

weakest_scene.visible_evidence: The narration says lakes and rivers hold 0.007%. On screen there is a growing disc labelled '100.0%' and a sliver label '0.0%'. Then the closing asks 'Would you have guessed it was this small?' over a disc that fills the frame.
weakest_scene.root_cause: A two-part share chart was rounded to one decimal place, so 0.007% shows as 0.0%. The animation grows the LOCKED-AWAY share instead of revealing the tiny reachable one, so the picture proves the opposite of the line.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Make the reachable water the hero. Data pours the whole Earth's water into a giant tank, then dips a tiny cup or drop out of it for lakes and rivers. Label it '0.007%' (never 0.0%), have it land by 4s, and keep the huge locked-away mass as the scale reference behind it.
